title: Account Manager - Digital Marketing
description:
Account Manager Digital Marketing

Location: Hybrid with 2 days per week in our Altrincham office
Salary: £35,000 to £40,000 dependent on experience
Contract: Full time, Permanent

Dark Horse is a renowned digital marketing agency based in Altrincham, specialising in PPC, Paid Social, SEO and Digital PR. With a diverse clientele and a commitment to delivering exceptional results.

We re after someone who cannot stand a missed deadline, takes pride in keeping every account on track, and genuinely gives a toss about clients getting the results they were promised.

This is a hybrid role based in Altrincham. No remote applications.

What s on offer

We think we ve built a great place to work, where every individual feels rewarded for the effort they put in.
- Salary of £35,000 to £40,000 DOE
- Hybrid working - 2 days a week in office
- Flexitime
- 27 days annual leave
- Plus your Birthday off
- Mental Wellbeing Bupa EAP programme
- Leafy Altrincham location
- Dark Horse will carbon offset your role with The Dark Forest
- Working in an amazing team with many fantastic people

The role

Reporting directly to the Head of Client Services and giving them a clear view of where your accounts stand. Our Service Leads own the day-to-day client conversations and channel strategy.

You are the one making sure the results are making a tangible impact; monitoring every KPI, keeping our health scoring and check-in cadence running like clockwork, and making sure nothing ever slips between us and the client.

This is a client guardianship and relationship role, not project management or day-to-day contact.

Throughout each month you will:
- Work with the Service Leads to monitor performance against KPIs across 40 accounts
- Pressure-test our monthly reports vs KPIs, coordinating feedback across channel specialists
- Spot channel specific comms and changes that affect other areas and make sure no-one is working in a silo
- Ensure all accounts get timely performance reviews, QBRs, prebreak and pre-renewal reviews
- Maintain accurate client health scores in (url removed)
- Spot amber and red movement before it becomes a problem and escalate fast
- Support renewals and cross-sell execution (materials, follow-up) without owning the commercial strategy or pricing

In order to be successful in this role you must have / be:
- Capable of having mature commercial conversations with business owners
- Experience in client services or account management, ideally in a performance or digital marketing agency
- Calm and organised managing a high volume of accounts (40-50 contracts)
- A confident, clear and humble communicator, written and verbal
- Comfortable asking and answering the hard commercial questions with senior client stakeholders
- Data-literate: you read performance metrics (CPA, spend, conversions) and understand the commercial story behind them

It would be great if you had:
- Hands-on exposure to PPC, Paid Social, SEO or Digital PR
- Experience working alongside specialist delivery teams
- Familiarity with (url removed) and with health-scoring or account tiering frameworks

This is a hybrid role based in Altrincham. No remote applications.

If you feel you have the necessary skills and experience to be successful in this role click on APPLY !

title: Accounts Assistant
company: JANE GORSE RECRUITMENT LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Assistant

Hale £25,000-£28,000

Supporting the Legal Cashiering Team

Good with numbers? Love getting the detail right? Ready for your next move in accounts?

Jane Gorse Recruitment is recruiting an Accounts Assistant to join an established law firm in Hale. You'll support the Legal Cashiering Team, helping to keep transactions accurate, payments running smoothly and financial records in excellent shape.

If you enjoy balancing the books, solving queries and being the person your colleagues can rely on, this could be a great next step.

The role

Working closely with the legal cashiers and wider business, you'll get involved in:
- Posting transactions accurately to client and office ledgers.
- Processing payments, cheque requests and account transfers.
- Completing daily bank reconciliations.
- Helping prepare weekly payment runs.
- Maintaining financial records and investigating ledger queries.
- Supporting month-end processes and VAT returns.
- Assisting with petty cash and residual client balances.
- Following the procedures that keep client money protected and accounts compliant.
- Providing cover for colleagues and suggesting ways to improve everyday processes.

What you'll bring

We're keen to hear from candidates with accounts experience, strong attention to detail and a proactive approach.

You'll be someone who:
- Enjoys working with numbers and checking that everything adds up.
- Has experience with financial transactions, reconciliations or maintaining accounts records.
- Communicates clearly and confidently with colleagues.
- Can organise a varied workload and meet deadlines.
- Handles sensitive financial information with care and discretion.
- Is comfortable using accounts software and learning new systems.
- Takes pride in being helpful, reliable and accurate.

Experience within a legal accounts team would be useful. If your background is in a different sector, please highlight your relevant accounts experience and interest in moving into legal finance.

The benefits

There's plenty on offer beyond the £25,000-£28,000 salary:
- Employee bonus scheme offering up to an additional 10% of annual salary, subject to terms and conditions.
- Your birthday off.
- Healthcare package including 24/7 GP access and contributions towards dental, optical and physiotherapy costs.
- Gym membership.
- Death-in-service cover of four times your salary.
- Company pension.
- Counselling support and monthly office massages.
- A range of lifestyle benefits, including Netflix, Spotify and Amazon Prime.

Benefits are subject to the employer's scheme terms and eligibility.

Ready to make your next move?

Apply with your CV to Jane Gorse Recruitment. We'd love to hear about your accounts experience and what you're looking for next.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Axon Moore are working with a growing business based in Altrincham to recruit a Credit Control Clerk into a newly created, standalone position.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller who enjoys a varied role, likes to get stuck in and wants the autonomy to take ownership of the ledger and make the role their own.

The business is continuing to grow, and this role will play an important part in supporting cash flow, maintaining strong customer relationships and improving processes across the finance function.

Location: Altrincham + Hybrid
Salary: 28,000 - 32,000

Main duties:

The position will be varied and is about much more than just chasing cash! Responsibilities will include:
- Raising and issuing accurate sales invoices and credit notes.
- Managing a ledger of B2 B customer accounts and proactively chasing outstanding debt.
- Reviewing aged debt, monitoring credit limits and escalating potential risks.
- Allocating customer payments and supporting month-end reconciliations.
- Investigating and resolving invoice queries, pricing discrepancies and customer debit notes.
- Working closely with sales, commercial and logistics teams to resolve queries.
- Maintaining accurate customer records and supporting new account setups and credit checks.
- Supporting improvements to processes, including the development of EDI and automation.
- Providing regular reporting and updates on aged debt, cash collection and outstanding queries.

Person specification:
- Previous experience in a B2 B credit control or sales ledger role.
- Ideally, experience within manufacturing, retail, FMCG or wholesale.
- Confident managing customer accounts, chasing debt and resolving queries independently.
- Organised, proactive and comfortable working in a standalone position.
- Someone who enjoys a challenge, takes ownership and is keen to contribute to a growing business.

Benefits:
- Early finish Fridays.
- Free on-site parking.
- Hybrid working
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- An additional day off for your birthday.
- Health cash plan, including cashback on eligible healthcare costs.
- Dental and eyecare benefits.
- Discounted gym membership.
- Electric car leasing scheme.
- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay.
- Company bonus.

title: Office Administrator
description:
About you

If you have experience working in an administration role within the construction industry and enjoy being part of a busy team, this could be a really good opportunity for you.

You will be joining an established office fit out contractor based in Altrincham, working in a varied role that combines construction administration with supporting the company's marketing and social media activity.

This could particularly suit someone who enjoys keeping things organised, helping colleagues and getting involved in different parts of a business rather than doing exactly the same thing every day.

You will need to be a positive, approachable person who is happy to get stuck in, work as part of a team and adapt when priorities change.

The role is fully office based in Altrincham, so ideally you will live locally or have a straightforward commute.

The starting salary is £25,000 per annum, plus bonus.

Working hours are either 8am to 4pm or 9am to 5pm, with a one hour lunch break.

Your experience

You will need previous experience in construction administration, ideally working for a main contractor, fit out contractor or refurbishment business.

You should understand how a construction office operates and be comfortable supporting colleagues with the administration involved in running projects and the wider business.

You will need to be organised, confident using Microsoft Office and comfortable managing different tasks throughout the day.

Alongside your administration experience, an interest in marketing and social media will be important.

Ideally, you will have some experience creating content for platforms such as LinkedIn, whether that involves writing posts, preparing simple graphics or helping promote a company's projects and achievements.

You do not need to be a marketing specialist, although you should be comfortable putting content together and willing to develop your skills.

Just as importantly, they are looking for someone with the right attitude.

You will need to be a team player who is positive, flexible and adaptable, someone who is happy to help wherever needed rather than seeing certain tasks as outside their job description.

What you will be doing with your experience

You will provide administration support to the team, helping with the day to day running of a busy construction office.

Your responsibilities will include general office administration, organising documents, maintaining records, preparing correspondence and supporting colleagues with project related paperwork.

You will help keep information organised and make sure administrative tasks are completed accurately and on time.

Alongside this, you will support the business with its marketing strategy, particularly around social media.

This could involve creating LinkedIn posts, helping prepare content about completed projects, organising photographs and contributing ideas for how the business can promote its work.

You will work with colleagues to gather information for marketing content and help turn that information into something suitable to share.

There will be a mixture of routine administration and more creative work, so you will need to be comfortable switching between tasks and responding to what the team needs.

The business is looking for someone who will take pride in their work, use their initiative and become a reliable part of the team.

About the business

You will be joining an established office fit out contractor with a turnover of approximately £10 million, based in Altrincham.

The business specialises in office fit out projects and is looking to strengthen its team with someone who can support both the administration side of the business and its marketing activity.

This is a full time, office based position, so you will be working closely with colleagues rather than remotely.

They are looking for someone who wants to become part of the business, build good working relationships and contribute wherever they can.

If you have construction administration experience, enjoy working with people and would like a role where you can also get involved in social media and marketing, this could be a really good fit.

The starting salary is £25,000 per annum, plus bonus.

Next steps

A CV isn't needed to start a conversation, so no matter what stage you're at in your job search, get in touch to discuss.

title: GP Receptionist / Administrator
description: We are creating a new role at Barrington Medical Centre to provide additional support across our reception and administration teams. This permanent, 37.5-hour post combines reception and administrative responsibilities, with a minimum of 15 hours per week supporting our reception service. The balance of duties will be directed by the Practice Manager or Reception Supervisor according to practice needs, including additional reception cover during annual leave and sickness. You will support a range of practice functions, sharing duties with colleagues according to workload and practice needs. These may include referrals, summarising patient records and administrative support for medical students and GP trainees. You will develop skills across the administrative team and provide support where needed. We are looking for someone who notices what needs doing and takes initiative. You will need sound judgement, good organisational skills and the ability to work accurately to targets and deadlines. Help patients with appointments and queries received in person, by telephone and online. Maintain the appointment system and guide patients to appropriate services. Process prescription requests in line with practice procedures, referring queries to the appropriate clinician when required. Respond to requests from patients, colleagues and external organisations, passing queries to the appropriate team when needed. Share administrative duties with colleagues including referrals, summarising records, clinical coding and support for medical students and GP trainees. Register new and temporary patients and update patient details. Process incoming and outgoing patient records. Scan, process and route workflow documents and correspondence. Carry out system searches and support patient invitations and recalls. Learn the basics of Quality and Outcomes Framework (QOF) administration and support the team with monitoring. Become familiar with the practices electronic processes for managing private work including medical reports, fees, invoicing and payments. Organise and prioritise work to meet agreed targets and deadlines. Identify outstanding tasks, take initiative and follow work through to completion. Provide flexible support across the team, including additional reception cover during annual leave and sickness. Maintain confidentiality and follow practice policies and procedures. Undertake training and duties as directed by the Practice Manager or Reception Supervisor. Job Summary To provide flexible support across the reception and administrative functions of the practice, working alongside colleagues to help maintain an organised, responsive and efficient service. This is an additional role within the team. It combines reception and administrative responsibilities, with a minimum of 15 hours per week supporting our reception service. The balance of duties will be directed by the Practice Manager or Reception Supervisor according to practice needs, including additional reception cover during annual leave and sickness. The postholder will develop skills across the administrative team and share duties with colleagues. These may include referrals, summarising patient records, document workflow, prescription requests, private income administration and support for medical students and GP trainees. The role requires sound judgement, initiative and the ability to organise work accurately to agreed targets and deadlines. Training and support will be provided, with duties undertaken according to the postholders competence. Maintain and monitor the practice appointment system. Process appointment requests received in person, by telephone and online. Answer incoming telephone calls, deal with requests appropriately and transfer calls when required. Guide patients to the appropriate service in accordance with practice procedures. Respond to queries efficiently and sensitively, recognising those requiring prompt attention. Initiate contact with patients, colleagues and external agencies as required. Record and pass on information and messages accurately. Support patients in accessing practice services and communicate clearly and respectfully. Maintain the reception area and patient notice boards. Complete opening and closing procedures in accordance with the duty rota. The postholder will learn and provide support across the following areas. Duties will be shared and allocated according to workload, priorities and staffing needs. Register new and temporary patients and update patient demographics. Process incoming and outgoing patient records, including relevant GP2GP tasks. Process incoming and outgoing correspondence. Scan and attach documentation to patient records where required. Process and route electronic workflow documents, completing administrative actions within agreed procedures. Enter information accurately into patient healthcare records. Undertake clinical coding and summarise patient records following appropriate training and practice guidance. Process referrals using the appropriate electronic systems, following clinical instructions and practice procedures. Monitor referral administration and follow up outstanding queries or actions. Carry out system searches and support patient invitations, recalls and follow-up correspondence. Learn the basics of Quality and Outcomes Framework (QOF) administration and support monitoring, recalls and follow-up as directed. Learn the practices electronic processes for managing private work, including medical reports, fees, invoicing and payments, to provide cover when required. Learn and support the processes for handling Subject Access Requests (SARs) in accordance with practice procedures. Provide administrative and organisational support for medical student placements and GP training. Provide cover for colleagues across the administrative team once trained. Organise and prioritise allocated work to meet agreed targets and deadlines. Review outstanding work and identify tasks requiring attention without waiting to be asked. Take initiative within the responsibilities of the role and seek guidance when needed. Follow tasks through to completion and maintain clear records of progress. Inform the Practice Manager or Reception Supervisor promptly if workloads, difficulties or delays may affect completion. Adapt to changing priorities and move between duties as directed. Work cooperatively with colleagues and support the wider multidisciplinary team. Provide additional reception cover during annual leave, sickness and other staffing pressures. Suggest practical improvements to administrative processes. Maintain a clean, tidy and organised working area. As required and following appropriate guidance or training: Support practice audits and administrative projects. Assist with meeting arrangements, agendas and minutes. Monitor and order stationery and other supplies. Attend team meetings and contribute to discussions about practice processes. Undertake other reasonable duties appropriate to the role, as directed by the Practice Manager or Reception Supervisor. Maintain patient and staff confidentiality at all times. Handle information securely and follow practice information governance procedures. Follow practice policies, procedures and relevant guidance. Report errors, incidents, near misses and concerns promptly. Recognise the limits of the role and refer clinical questions or decisions to an appropriate clinician. Treat patients, visitors and colleagues with respect. Complete mandatory training and participate in training relevant to the role. The postholder will be expected to develop a working knowledge of the different reception and administrative functions of the practice. Training will be provided in relevant systems and processes. The postholder must be willing to learn, act on feedback and take increasing responsibility as competence develops. This job description outlines the main responsibilities of the post. The allocation of duties may change according to service needs, workload and staffing levels. It will be reviewed with the postholder as the role develops.
